author: pgaudet
RLovering
body:
Hi Pascale
I am going through these but I disagree with some of these. I think that removing some from ECM CC term is not always correct, for example adhesion molecules are likely to be in the ECM because they will be connecting through the ECM to bind to other molecules on the surface of adjacent cells.
I have highlighted the annotations which I disagree with. While I have listed these as checked and unchanged, I am updating these to ECM term, so they are being changed but they are not being deleted as requested. - hope that makes sense.
I think that the issue here lies with the query re ECM CC term. Perhaps the matrisome project should look more closely at the MF terms eg:
	
GO:0005201 extracellular matrix structural constituent
GO:0030023 extracellular matrix constituent conferring elasticity
GO:0030020 extracellular matrix structural constituent conferring tensile strength

as this might be more what they are implying with their requirement for the removal of proteins from the ECM which are in the ECM due to their actual location even though these proteins might not have an actual role in ECM function.

author: pgaudet
body: Thank you for looking into this! We'll get back to you shortly.

author: Matrisome
body:
@RLovering Thank you for your comments. As soon as we are done with the curation and revisions of the CC terms pertaining to matrisome gene products, we will work on MF terms. 
Note that the obsoletion of the "GO:0062023 collagen-containing extracellular matrix" CC term does not mean we are getting rid of the notion altogether. We have proposed a completely new framework, with new CC terms, to structure ECM "components"/sublocalization, see: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29267
